text: The Patriots' offensive struggles have reached a crisis point as the team sits dead last in the NFL in points per game at 9.7, a problem that intensified Sunday with a 35-6 blowout loss to Jacksonville in which Drake Maye threw two interceptions and fumbled once—a performance the quarterback himself characterized as "unacceptable." The offensive line took another blow Tuesday when guard Greg Van Roten was placed on injured reserve with a thigh injury, further compromising the infrastructure around Maye just as questions mount about whether the Patriots are utilizing their young quarterback effectively in the first place. As New England prepares to travel to Highmark Stadium to face the Bills on Sunday at 1 PM ET, the film breakdown from Jacksonville reveals fundamental issues with both Maye's execution and the offense's overall scheme, leaving the team searching for answers on both sides of the ball.
